notes:
LargeDownloadConfirmation.needsConfirmation(chapterCount: Int, defaults: UserDefaults) -> Bool returns `defaults.bool(forKey: AppSettings.downloads.confirmLargeDownloads.key) && chapterCount > threshold` (threshold = 50, strict). Tests in AidokuTests/LargeDownloadConfirmationTests cover 50 and 51 with the setting on, 51 off and 51 never stored, each in a throwaway UserDefaults suite. Slice gate with prove was GREEN; the only finding is a non-gating nit that slice builds the Aidoku area rather than running its tests.
